title: Wave Download Event Type - Data API
description: Wave Download events represent downloads made from lens explorations and dashboard widgets in the CRM Analytics user interface. A Wave Download event type is captured when a user downloads images ( .png ), Microsoft® Excel® data ( .xls ), or comma-separated values ( .csv ) files.

ASSET_ID.description: The ID of the asset the user downloads from.

ASSET_TYPE.description: The type of the asset the user downloads from.

CLIENT_IP.description: The IP address of the client that’s using Salesforce services. A Salesforce internal IP (such as a login from AppExchange) is shown as “Salesforce.com IP”.

CPU_TIME.description: The CPU time in milliseconds used to complete the request. This field indicates the amount of activity taking place in the app server layer.

DATASET_IDS.description: Comma-separated list of IDs of utilized data sets.

DOWNLOAD_ERROR.description: The message for the error blocking the download request, if any.

DOWNLOAD_FORMAT.description: The data format of the export.

EVENT_TYPE.description: The type of event. The value is always WaveDownload.

LOGIN_KEY.description: The string that ties together all events in a given user’s login session. It starts with a login event and ends with either a logout event or the user session expiring.

REQUEST_ID.description: The unique ID of a single transaction. A transaction can contain one or more events. Each event in a given transaction has the same REQUEST_ID.

RUN_TIME.description: The amount of time that the request took in milliseconds.

SESSION_KEY.description: The user’s unique session ID. You can use this value to identify all user events within a session. When a user logs out and logs in again, a new session is started.

TIMESTAMP.description: The access time of Salesforce services in GMT. For example: 20130715233322.670.

TIMESTAMP_DERIVED.description: The access time of Salesforce services in ISO8601-compatible format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ). For example: 2015-07-27T11:32:59.555Z. Timezone is GMT.

URI.description: The URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

URI_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the URI of the page that’s receiving the request.

USER_ID.description: The 15-character ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.

USER_ID_DERIVED.description: The 18-character case insensitive ID of the user who’s using Salesforce services through the UI or the API.

WAVE_SESSION_ID.description: The ID of a particular session of CRM Analytics. Use this field to determine which log lines originated from a particular session.

WAVE_TIMESTAMP.description: The time at which this log line was generated.
